app.title: EqubFlow
app.tagline: Decentralized rotating savings group on Arc Testnet
badge.accelerated: Rounds are sped up for this demo. A real circle would meet weekly or monthly.
banner.paused: The organizer paused this circle. No payments will move until it resumes.
banner.offline: You are offline. What you see may be out of date.
auth.email_helper: We will send you a one-time sign-in code.
auth.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
auth.code_wrong: That code does not match. Check the newest email and try again.
auth.code_expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.resend_timer: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} seconds.
auth.session_expired: For your safety, please sign in again before sending money.
payment.submitted: Sent. We are waiting for the network to confirm it. This usually takes a few seconds.
payment.confirmed: Confirmed. Your contribution for round {n} is recorded.
payment.failed: The payment did not go through. Nothing was taken from your account. Try again, or tell the organizer.
approval.empty: Nothing needs your decision right now.
approval.beneficiary_lock: You cannot decide this one because it involves you.
verify.record_intact: The record is intact. {count} entries, checked just now.
verify.record_changed: The record changed at entry {n}. Do not rely on anything after it.
